name: agentos-live-frozen-v1
frozen: Labels authored and committed before any model run on this set. Do not edit labels after observing outputs; add a new versioned file instead.
grading: Every check is programmatic against the case's own synthetic records and documents. Numbers match by value (sign-agnostic, percent-aware); strings match case-insensitively; a list means any-of. See backend/agentos/live_eval.py.

cases.goal: Compare the inventory and capacity policies for the East depot's reserve stock. Identify the conflicting thresholds, explain the operational risk, and give a cited recommendation with uncertainties.

documents.inventory-policy: East depot inventory policy. The East depot must keep at least twenty reserve pallets on site to cover supply interruptions. Reducing reserve stock requires the inventory owner's approval.
documents.capacity-policy: East depot capacity policy. The East depot may keep at most twelve reserve pallets on site to maintain fire-lane clearance. The capacity owner must review any proposed exception.
documents.travel-policy: Employee travel policy. Rail fares are reimbursed upon submission of receipts.

documents.holiday-calendar: The office is closed on November 26 and November 27, 2026.
